source_clause: LS5.) Once the minimum or maximum level has been reach, the system will grey out the (-, +) control. So if the user is increasing their lumbar, once the maximum has been reached, pressing the (+) button again will result in error tone being triggered.
reasoning: 驗證目標：13.6（LS5.）到達上下限後控制被 grey out，以及再按觸發 error tone。關鍵情境條件：本節為 ch13 唯一使用 level 一詞者，故 ER 保留該詞；error tone 照錄條文措辭，其頻率、時長、視覺回饋一律不寫（條文未給）。為什麼這樣切：兩個 037 leaf 對應兩者，distinguishing axis 為 observable channel —— -01 驗視覺（greyed out），-02 驗聽覺加上級距不再變化。刻意略過：不標 BLOCKED（R-C22：值不知道但事件看得見）；設計方法取 BVA 而非負向測試，因於上限再按 (+) 是合法輸入落在邊界，非注入非法值。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: lower screen Seats tab 與 error tone

tcs.tc_title: Control is greyed out at the minimum and maximum level
tcs.test_item:
LS5.) Once the minimum or maximum level has been reach, the system will grey out the (-, +) control.

(read how the "-" control is presented -> The "-" control is greyed out)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [test-setup] The Seats tab is open and the lumbar/bolster level is away from both its minimum and its maximum
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "+" repeatedly until the lumbar/bolster level stops increasing
2. Read how the "+" control is presented
3. Press "-" repeatedly until the lumbar/bolster level stops decreasing
4. Read how the "-" control is presented
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lumbar/bolster reaches its maximum level and stops changing
2. The "+" control is greyed out
3. The lumbar/bolster reaches its minimum level and stops changing
4. The "-" control is greyed out
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.test_item_authored: Once the minimum or maximum level has been reach, the system shall grey out the (-, +) control

tcs.tc_title: Error tone is played when pressing beyond the maximum level
tcs.test_item:
So if the user is increasing their lumbar, once the maximum has been reached, pressing the (+) button again will result in error tone being triggered.

(press "+" once more on the door seat control -> An error tone is played and the lumbar/bolster stays at its maximum level)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [test-setup] The cabin is quiet enough for a tone to be heard
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "+" repeatedly until the lumbar/bolster stops increasing
2. Press "+" once more on the door seat control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lumbar/bolster is at its maximum level
2. An error tone is played and the lumbar/bolster stays at its maximum level
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.test_item_authored: So if the user is increasing their lumbar, once the maximum has been reached, pressing the (+) button again will result in error tone being triggered
